Questline.Title: {=sp_ka_title}The Black Ledger & The Web of Shadows

Stage.LogText: {=sp_ka_s0_log}A dying black pigeon collapsed onto your campfire, its claws clutching a scorched parchment written in the fugitive artisan's trembling hand: 'You gave me mercy, and now I give you truth. Dost is not serving the Motherland; he is turning it into an abattoir. The Black Ledger (The Black Ledger) detailing every manufactured war and staged assassination is hidden in {GizliSehir_Link}. Find the broker {KaraMuhbir_Link} before Dost's silencers bury the truth.'
{=sp_ka_s1_log}Ride to {GizliSehir_Link} and locate the underworld broker {KaraMuhbir_Link}. You must uncover the location of the cipher vault holding the Black Ledger.

{=sp_ka_s2_log}Just as {KaraMuhbir_Link} confessed, Dost's death squad {GolgeSuikastcilar_Link} ambushed the district to silence anyone seeking the Black Ledger! Slay the assassins to survive and secure the coordinates to the cipher vault.
{=sp_ka_s3_log}With the assassins broken, seek out the vault keeper {KasaKorumasi_Link} in {GizliSehir_Link} to unlock the iron casket and seize the Black Ledger.

{=sp_ka_s_success_log}The Black Ledger (The Black Ledger) is now in your hands! Its blackened pages expose Dost and the Scavenger Pigeons as the architects behind endless border conflicts across Calradia. Armed with the realm's deadliest blackmail, you gained 60,000 denars, 60 renown, and cemented your feared standing in the shadows.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_ka_dlg_m_entry}I am looking for the one who keeps records of the shadow trade.
{=sp_ka_dlg_m_intro}Keep your voice down, stranger! The street stones have ears, and Dost's silencers are lurking around every corner. Who sent you into my den?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p1_inq}A dying black pigeon reached me from the frontier. The fugitive artisan told me you hold the key to the Black Ledger.
{=sp_ka_dlg_p1_skep}You look terrified. Are you an honest broker of secrets, or another bait laid out by Dost?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p1_prag}I didn't come to exchange pleasantries. Point me to the cipher archive, or I leave you to Dost's hounds.
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_m_pigeon_reveal}So the artisan's bird reached someone after all... That brave fool tried to stop the war machine. What do you want from an old bookkeeper like me? Knowing what is inside that ledger is a death warrant across the whole continent!
{=sp_ka_dlg_p2_why}Why a death warrant? What could be written on parchment that frightens every lord in Calradia?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p2_dost}How deeply is Dost involved? Is he merely a rogue operative, or does the entire Scavenger Pigeon leadership answer to him?
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_m_ledger_lore}It is the ledger of manufactured wars! Over forty lords from three rival kingdoms paid Dost to assassinate legitimate heirs, poison wells, and stage border raids. Dost orchestrates the slaughter, and the Pigeons sell both sides the intelligence to fight! The ledger is Dost's ultimate insurance against kings.
{=sp_ka_dlg_p3_power}Whoever controls this ledger holds the collar of every corrupt ruler in Calradia. Where is the vault?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p3_doubt}If Dost keeps such a dangerous record here, his personal guard cannot be far behind.
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_m_ambush_panic}You're right! Curse the heavens—look past the alleyway! Shadow cloaks and drawn crossbows... Dost's elite death squad has encircled the district! They know I've revealed the location! We are cornered!
{=sp_ka_dlg_p4_fight_heroic}Let Dost send his butchers. Today, the shadows bleed like mortals! (Draw Steel & Defend)
{=sp_ka_dlg_p4_fight_prag}Barricade the inner door, old man. I will turn their ambush into their graveyard. (Fight)
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_entry}The assassins outside will bother you no longer. I have come for the Black Ledger.
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_intro}You cut down Dost's elite blades like wheat... I watched from the parapet. The iron casket is right here, sealed under the mark of the Raven Bone.
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_inq}What is the most damning truth recorded within these pages?
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_skep}How do I know this isn't another forged deception crafted to misdirect my blade?
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_prag}Enough philosophy. Crack the seals and place the casket in my custody.
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_k_reveal}Every wax seal on these sheets bears the personal crest of Dost and the secret council. It proves that every skirmish, every raided caravan, and every slandered noble in the realm was orchestrated to siphon wealth into the Scavenger Pigeons' coffers. Whoever holds this holds the leash of Calradia's rulers.
{=sp_ka_dlg_fin_ruler}With this ledger, Dost's puppet empire is finished. From now on, the shadows answer to me. (Claim the Black Ledger)
{=sp_ka_dlg_fin_prag}Power and gold always follow the truth. I will keep this weapon close. (Claim the Black Ledger)
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
